title: Invertibility of the specified tensor-pullback dual comparison
statement: For a morphism h:T→W of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and a finite locally free O_W-module M [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], the morphism δ_M:P_h(M^∨)→(P_hM)^∨ defined by transposing pulled internal-Hom evaluation in [lem-sc-picard-canonical-base-change-comparisons] is invertible. This is an assertion about that specified morphism, not existence of an arbitrary isomorphism.

source.place: Finite locally free duality via the dual-tensor-Hom isomorphism and evaluation; transport of that duality by the monoidal pullback functor.

proof.text: Rewrite the closed comparison ihomUnitTensorToIhom M M as the sheaf dualTensorHom comparison, using the existing equality theorem. Its finite-locally-free IsIso instance gives the canonical exactPairingOfIsIso, with evaluation equal to internal-Hom evaluation.

Transport the monoidal structure of ordinary pullback along picardTensorComparison and map this exact pairing by ExactPairing.map. The transpose of the resulting evaluation is an isomorphism by curry_evaluation. Compose its target with internal Hom of the unit automorphism formed from the inverse transported unit map and picardTensorUnitIso. Currying naturality identifies this invertible composite with δ_M. Expand transport_μ and picardTensorObjIso to verify that identification. This covers empty schemes and rank zero.
